content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"This judge text does the thing K-C governs: it decides a link pressed by the challenger's own chain by separating the wording and application rather than weighing the chains by footing.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse: (1) it requires the judge to compare the whole chains supporting the link, so dividing Isaiah 7:14 into wording and application is a breach; (2) it only forbids the stating-verse test, so an underdetermined result after answering different sub-issues is allowed.","why":"The judge did not weigh the Isaiah 7:14 chains against each other by footing but treated the challenger's wording answer and defender's application answer as separate, leaving the link underdetermined."}
